title: Japanese for Hotels in 9 Comic Scenes | Guess, Listen, Say It (Travel Japanese)
lead: Check-in, breakfast, Wi-Fi, a broken air conditioner and leaving your bags, everything for a Japanese hotel in nine comic scenes. Guess first, then listen twice and say it.

intro.title:
Japan hotel
**9 phrases**
intro.say: Nine scenes in a Japanese hotel. Guess each line before the answer.

phrases.label: Checking in
phrases.ja: チェックインお願いします。
phrases.ko: I'd like to check in, please.
phrases.when: At the front desk, say this.
phrases.tip: Show your passport at the same time. Hotels in Japan check the passports of foreign guests.
phrases.short: Check in at a Japanese hotel
phrases.scene: At the wooden front desk, Jiwoo stands with a rolling suitcase and holds out her passport with a smile; the clerk behind the counter greets her with a small bow; Minjun stands behind Jiwoo with a backpack.

phrases.label: I have a booking
phrases.ja: 予約しています。キムです。
phrases.ko: I have a reservation. My name is Kim.
phrases.when: When the clerk asks for your name, give the name on the booking like this.
phrases.tip: Put your own family name where it says Kimu. You can also show the booking on your phone.
phrases.hear: お名前をお願いします。 (Onamae o onegai shimasu.) = Your name, please.
phrases.scene: At the front desk, the clerk asks a question with an open hand; Jiwoo points to herself and then shows a booking screen on her phone (no readable writing).

phrases.label: Breakfast time
phrases.ja: 朝食は何時からですか？
phrases.pron: Choushoku wa nanji kara desu ka?
phrases.when: To ask when breakfast starts, say this.
phrases.tip: Nanji kara means from what time, and nanji made means until what time.
phrases.scene: At the front desk, the clerk hands Jiwoo a key card in a small plain envelope; Jiwoo takes it and asks with a curious look, miming eating with chopsticks.

phrases.label: Wi-Fi password
phrases.ja: Wi-Fiのパスワードは何ですか？
phrases.pron: Wai-fai no pasuwaado wa nan desu ka?
phrases.when: To ask for the Wi-Fi password, say this.
phrases.tip: It is often written in the room guide or on the key card envelope.
phrases.scene: Still at the front desk, Jiwoo holds up her phone showing a blank Wi-Fi symbol and asks; the clerk smiles and points to a small plain card on the counter.

phrases.label: One more, please
phrases.ja: タオルをもう一枚ください。
phrases.tip: Mou ichimai means one more sheet. Swap taoru for other things too.
phrases.scene: In the hotel corridor outside her room door, Jiwoo holds up one finger and a single folded towel, asking the clerk who is passing by on the right.

phrases.label: Something is broken
phrases.ja: エアコンが動きません。
phrases.when: If something in your room is broken, say this.
phrases.tip: Swap eakon for other things, like terebi, the TV.
phrases.short: Something broken in your hotel room?
phrases.scene: In the compact guest room, Jiwoo holds a remote control and points at the silent wall-mounted air conditioner, fanning her face; the clerk has come to the room and looks up at the unit on the right.

phrases.label: Checking out
phrases.ja: チェックアウトお願いします。
phrases.ko: I'd like to check out, please.
phrases.when: When you leave, hand back the key and say this.
phrases.tip: Some hotels have a box for key cards instead. Just follow what the front desk says.
phrases.scene: Back at the front desk in the morning, Jiwoo places a key card on the counter with her suitcase beside her; the clerk takes it with both hands and bows slightly.

phrases.label: Leaving your bags
phrases.ja: 荷物を預かってもらえますか？
phrases.when: After checking out, want to leave your bags and go sightseeing? Ask this.
phrases.tip: Many hotels keep bags before check-in and after check-out. Keep the claim tag they give you.
phrases.scene: At the front desk, Jiwoo pats the handle of her rolling suitcase and asks; the clerk nods and holds out a small plain claim tag; Minjun holds a city guidebook with a blank cover.

bonus.label: Calling a taxi
bonus.ja: タクシーを呼んでもらえますか？
bonus.ko: Could you call a taxi for me?
bonus.when: Finally, if you need a taxi, ask the front desk like this.
bonus.scene: At the front desk, Jiwoo mimes holding a steering wheel with a hopeful smile; the clerk picks up a desk phone with a nod.

outro.title: Recap: **9 phrases**
outro.say: All the phrases are in the description. Tell us in the comments how many you got right. Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
